findings.highlight: I averted my gaze to see if you would be agitated by it
findings.evidenceJa: この程度では動じないだろう、と期待して視線を逸らした
findings.governingReading: Saber looked away while expecting that an opening of this degree would not shake or lure Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English changes her expectation of composure into a test designed to discover whether he would become agitated.
